items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: And then Bill said this and then Kenneth Starr said no you can’t do that.

ctx.x: All the gas that’s been burned up getting to the scene of the latest person who said something in a room with other people there. I heard a great thing on NPR last week. A reporter did a story about the Monica Lewinsky thing from the perspective that she turned everyone into fifth graders. And say well Bill said that Monica didn’t do this thing, and Monica said that she got a phone call from so-and-so that said that Paula did, and she didn’t like it, and this kind of — and they went through the whole story. And…
whole thing is, and I hope the whole world laughs at us because we’re incredibly stupid to pay any attention to it, like we are to racism. Thank you very much.
